description: This file defines a custom RecyclerView.ItemDecoration class 'GridSpacingItemDecoration' that manages spacing between items in a grid layout, allowing configuration of spacing, number of columns, and edge inclusion.

classes.name: GridSpacingItemDecoration
classes.description: A custom ItemDecoration for RecyclerView to control spacing between grid items with configurable gaps and edge spacing options.

methods.name: getItemOffsets
methods.description: Overrides RecyclerView.ItemDecoration.getItemOffsets to set the spacing offsets for each item in the grid based on position, span count, and whether edges are included.
